manifest.name: counter
manifest.description: Stateful counter with an owner-bound inline callback

source: fn view(n) { #{ text: "Counter: " + n, buttons: [[#{text:"+", action:#{"type":"module","module":"counter","function":"increment",args:#{}}}]], ttl_seconds: 3600 } } fn counter(args, config) { let n = if type_of(state) == "map" { state.count } else { 0 }; #{screen:view(n),state:#{count:n}} } fn increment(event, config) { let n = state.count + config.step; #{state:#{count:n},screen:view(n)} } fn tick(event, config) { #{text: "Counter reminder"} }
